specification.selection: Coordinates and intervals fixed before evaluating this benchmark. Geographic coverage cases, not statistically representative mission sites. Do not tune these cases or acceptance limits to make a result pass.

acceptance.meaning: Project numerical regression budgets for a demonstration planning tool, not NASA requirements or physical accuracy guarantees. Report verdict changes separately, even when differences fit the budgets.

controlled_maps.qualification: Not an exact reproduction: published map exact start epoch is unconfirmed; its LDEM_65S_240M differs from the adjusted LDEM_60S_240MPP_ADJ used here. No pass tolerance assigned to this contextual comparison.

limits: Numerical checks are conditional on the DEM, interpolation and idealized hardware assumptions.
Six geographic holdouts are not statistical or telemetry validation; the geographic cases were selected before this run.
SPICE and Horizons share JPL ephemeris heritage. A second code path is not independent physical truth.
The exhaustive search check covers only its specified 147 scenarios. No global optimum is established.
The published-map experiment cannot establish physical error bounds with unmatched epochs and DEM realizations.
